DitherGradient.angle: Direction, as in CSS. 180deg runs top to bottom.
DitherGradient.from: Tone at the start, from 0 (paper) to 1 (ink).
DitherGradient.cell: Size of one dither cell, rounded to whole device pixels.
DitherGradient.palette: Two or more colours, from paper to ink.
DitherGradient.levels: Snaps the tone to this many steps. 0 keeps every tone the matrix can draw.
